events.label: Company founded
events.summary: Collibra is founded in Belgium as a data-governance software company and VUB spin-off.

events.label: Early founding team evolution
events.summary: Damien Trog contributed major initial engineering work during the early years; Benny Verhaeghe joined after the first years and established an early enterprise revenue base. This nuance is tracked as topic lineage metadata rather than asserted in the outward article.

events.label: BCBS 239 published
events.summary: The Basel Committee publishes BCBS 239, a landmark framework for effective risk data aggregation and reporting that helps explain demand for trustworthy enterprise data controls.

events.label: GDPR adopted
events.summary: The European Union adopts the General Data Protection Regulation, strengthening the compliance context for enterprise data governance.

events.label: Unicorn milestone
events.summary: Collibra passes a $1 billion valuation amid broader coverage of regulatory pressure for data governance.

events.label: OwlDQ acquisition
events.summary: Collibra acquires OwlDQ to expand into data quality.

events.label: Husprey acquisition
events.summary: Collibra acquires Husprey to add notebook-oriented analytics tooling.

events.label: AI governance expansion
events.summary: Collibra launches AI-governance capabilities as regulatory and operational attention shifts toward trustworthy AI.

events.label: Raito and Deasy Labs acquisitions
events.summary: Collibra adds data-access governance through Raito and unstructured-data governance through Deasy Labs.
